en.t: There was a two-day break in between.

units.source_text: 第三天对局的早晨，名人和七段两人都说肚子痛。

en.t: On the morning of the third day of play, both the Meijin and the seventh-dan player said their stomachs hurt.

units.source_text: 据说大竹七段五点就醒来了。

en.t: It is said that Otake seventh-dan had already woken up at five o'clock.
